name: BEST-2
summary: BEST-2 is a proposed follow-up to BEST using a cobalt-58 electron-neutrino source and a three-zone gallium target. Its different neutrino energy and finer spatial sampling would test the gallium anomaly and distinguish possible oscillation patterns.
detection_principle: Neutrino capture on gallium-71 creates germanium-71 atoms. Separate chemical extraction and low-background decay counting in three target zones would compare capture probabilities at different distances from the source.

status.label: Proposed
status.evidence: The 2025 paper proposes the cobalt-58 experiment. An exposure with that source was not established by the reviewed sources.

timeline.event: Predecessor BEST exposed a two-zone target to chromium-51
